title: Render Farm Incident Response
description: Render farm incidents affecting media production
immediate_actions: Assess impact on production timelines and rendering schedules
Implement alternative rendering resources if available
Contact production team for deadline impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review render farm logs and node status
Check network connectivity to rendering nodes
Verify rendering software and license availability
Analyze rendering job queue and failures
resolution_steps: Restart failed rendering nodes following standard procedures
Implement network fixes if connectivity issues
Apply rendering software patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with rendering software vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with production staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Production incidents during live shoots receive P1 priority
Rendering timelines are critical for production schedules
Coordinate with production team for deadline management
Document any rendering delays that may affect production
